reason: We are going into a new country in the next months and I have no network there, so the referrals and fairs that work at home will not carry me. If the 15 free companies look like real buyers I know, I would try the pilot in relationship mode, because the first three meetings cost me nothing and I can mark the bad ones free.
objection: I still think a junior SDR with Apollo could do this for less, and one logistics client with 45 meetings is not proof for a wholesaler like me. I am afraid of meetings that look qualified on paper but are with people who will never switch suppliers, and of my name being on messages that sound like spam to people I will meet again at fairs.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies is generic or full of names I already know are not buyers, I stop there.
